    Almost-split morphisms in short exact sequences #

    This file records three intrinsic facts used to rotate the density-free push-down theorem. A right almost-split morphism has indecomposable target; a radical kernel map in a short exact sequence makes the quotient map right minimal; and a right-minimal right almost-split quotient makes the displayed kernel map left almost split.
